claims.statement: mc/check.sh fails when gofmt -l lists any file and runs untagged go vet.
The Go gate vets nightly, docker_e2e, docker_boundary, test_fake_routing, and test_scratch_spine builds, and Linux arm64 builds with and without test_scratch_spine.
mc/check.sh runs the deployment and testenv package tests with -count=1 because these tests read files outside the Go module.
mc/check.sh runs install, redeploy, and uninstall contract tests, then the Go suite through test.sh with Linux scratch-spine selection.
mc/test.sh fails a go test invocation whose output contains no === RUN line, reporting that the selected group executed zero tests.
release/check.sh fails when unittest discovery selects zero tests.
The CI fast suite runs ten component checks and rejects non-mc logs without a positive pass count.
The fast suite job runs ./release/check.sh before it builds the application package.
The deployment-linux CI job runs the portable deployment tests with -count=1 and the Linux filesystem guard tests in substrate.
The docker_e2e suite drives one task through the real mc, the real resident timer, and real containers, and never calls mc dispatch.
The untagged property honesty and mutant gates and the nightly properties share one case corpus.
evals/check.sh runs culler-evals check, which runs pytest in evals and reports zero model calls.
The host stores captured evaluation cases under MC_HOME/evals/cases/ with owner-only access when the development flag authorizes a Packager run.
On Linux, mc/test.sh adds -tags=test_scratch_spine unless the caller passes a -tags argument.
mc/test.sh prints one UNVERIFIED line with the package, the test, and the skip reason for each skipped test, and a count of the skipped tests.
On Linux, mc/check.sh runs the filesystem guard tests in ./substrate/ again with -tags= after the full Go test run.
Each Bun component preloads runner/shared/test-environment.ts through bunfig.toml, and that file removes the run variables and points MC_RUN_JSON and MC_RUN_LOG_DIR at absent paths.
The Linux CI job fails if the production filesystem guard checks report any UNVERIFIED test.
The packet context tests cover report fences, media replacement, the 128 KiB text limit, unavailable reports, and exclusion of mutable packet state.
The packet artifact Docker test checks task report and evidence reads, refused writes, and isolation from another task.
The packet conversation tests cover current identity, shared preparation, resume, deletion, archive refusal, and model restrictions.
The dependency reuse acceptance script exercises fresh offline Worker preparation after setup through npm, Bun, and uv home caches.
The dependency reuse acceptance script checks concurrent role files, image and process replacement, Project separation, legacy archives, and cache removal.
The browser report gate rejects zero tests, failures, errors, skips, and missing expected suite files.
The smoke script checks a JUnit report after every run and requires all smoke files when called without arguments.
The CI browser job installs Playwright from the default Project image lock file and installs its matching Chromium.
The fast tests check the browser gate's exit behavior, screenshot paths, and release workflow dependencies.
The published release record requires five checks, while the workflow requires dashboard-browser before both publication jobs.
Security unit tests cover severity counts, packages without a version, absent inventories and version records, masked reports, job summaries, and scanner download retries.
The scanner acceptance test reports a new high-severity advisory in an unchanged image.
The scanner acceptance tests check that a failed tool or an absent image layer leaves the scan unverified and that the failed tool report omits a synthetic credential.
Workflow tests check the release-checks prerequisites, that no job waits for a scan job, read-only pull request jobs, exact image reuse, and nightly report retention.
The image load tests check that the image identity is the digest of the image configuration and that an image of another commit fails.
The report-frame smoke checks fixed page styles, preserved diagram styles, and absent fixture overflow at 1280- and 390-pixel viewport widths.
The review unit tests check the styled empty body and stable report serialization with link rules.
The packet chat browser tests check pointer and keyboard resize, width retention, draft preservation, and narrow layout limits.
The Discord browser smoke uses real host commands and a local configuration service with simulated Discord responses.
The Packet divider smoke waits for the narrow conversation and restores the desktop viewport before cleanup resets the divider.
The configuration tests reject unsupported connection kinds, custom provider destinations, credential values, and empty base_url declarations.
The credential projection container test exercises both supported channels with a local token authority and synthetic grants.
The runtime access verifier test checks refusal of an unsupported authority before any request and without exposing the refresh value.
The Verifier compares submitted failures with the base under comparable conditions and treats matching check and cause as an unchanged failure.
An unchanged failure outside the criteria permits task PASS when criteria, new or changed tests, and regression assessment satisfy the contract.
The Verifier must execute later independent checks after an early failure when the container supports them.
The Packager preserves every UNVERIFIED entry and base comparisons without an additional approval requirement.
Arbiter criteria tests cover accepted invalid and mixed batches, malformed batch refusals, rollback, and all-reject with other ready work.
The report-frame smoke expects a #fdfdfe root and body background, #172f47 body text, and a light color scheme at both tested widths.
The dashboard theme unit tests check the picture selection, button state, storage updates, and theme-specific grid tokens.
The theme browser smoke checks the grid in both themes, the picture toggle and reload, the veil, and the chick animation period.
The focused Go and resident tests cover provider access before the first setup heartbeat and refusal after the environment operation ends.
Workspace preview tests distinguish a file path from a missing parent directory.
The Discord conversation smoke checks dashboard and thread continuity across an idle period and connector restart.
The resident recovery integration tests use synthetic credentials and Go connection controls to verify retry timing and launch admission.
The resident recovery integration tests verify obsolete renewal results, overlapping ticks, and stopped authorization.
The Go renewal tests verify repeated transport failures, retained diagnostic evidence, and obsolete results.
The resident unit tests verify condition selection, asynchronous renewal, and cancellation after failure.
The profile and adapter tests cover effort validation, catalog levels, model test errors, and adapter arguments.
The dashboard model configuration smoke checks effort selection and profile display.
The dashboard model configuration smoke checks profile Edit actions in the role assignment dialog.
The culler command tests cover lifecycle behavior and failures.
The command installation tests cover path and executable safety checks.
The release image job checks the contents of both saved images and writes a size report from those archives.
The local release check runs the image archive, content, and size report Python tests.
The host source sign-in test fixture restores directory write access before it renames a sealed credential directory.
The dashboard smoke harness rejects a scratch Discord socket path above 103 bytes before it creates the home.
The CI browser job sets MC_SMOKE_ROOT below RUNNER_TEMP/smoke.
